quarterly_data.quarter: MiTAC Holdings press release: MiTAC Computing Showcases Full-Stack Innovation to Scale (10-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Subsidiary MiTAC Computing made the global debut of the C2611Z6 at the 2026 OCP Global Summit (October 12, 2026): a liquid-cooled multi-node server for OCP ORv3 racks powered by AMD EPYC 9006 Series processors, with four compute nodes in a 2OU form factor, each supporting 16 DDR5-8000 RDIMM slots and OCP 3.0 expansion. It also showed the G4520G6 (G4520G6E3BC-N), a 4U2S enterprise AI-inference server on Intel Xeon 6 processors supporting up to eight NVIDIA RTX PRO 4500 / NVIDIA 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs or NVIDIA H200 GPUs with 12 NVMe E3.S drive bays, and its G4826Z5 liquid-cooled AI server (AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs, AMD ROCm), which is built into the TonoForge Modular Data Center developed with Tonomia (the company cites a proven 12-week deployment). The two-phase liquid-cooling work with ZutaCore on the G4826Z5 is a proof of concept.
quarterly_data.figure: C2611Z6: four compute nodes in 2OU, 16 DDR5-8000 RDIMM slots per node; G4520G6: up to eight GPUs, 12 NVMe E3.S bays; TonoForge 12-week deployment (company claim)
